# agentgateway-crds

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/crdgen. Do not edit. -->

CustomResourceDefinitions for agentgateway (backends, models, parameters, policies).

CRDs are copied verbatim from [agentgateway/agentgateway](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway)
at tag [`v1.6.0`](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway/tree/v1.6.0) (commit `ea5608642b9d5c94c5baf5fd9f2f9849b808e963`),
path(s) `controller/install/helm/agentgateway-crds/templates`, and rendered as regular Helm templates so that
`helm upgrade` updates them (Helm's own `crds/` directory never upgrades).

## Install

```sh
helm install agentgateway oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/agentgateway-crds --version <version>
```

Chart `version` equals the upstream version it ships; `appVersion` is always the exact upstream version.
Installing requires Kubernetes >=1.25.0.

### Already have these CRDs?

If the CRDs were installed by the operator chart or `kubectl apply`, Helm refuses with
"rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists". Either let Helm adopt them:

```sh
helm install agentgateway oci://ghcr.io/spnngl/charts/agentgateway-crds --version <version> --take-ownership   # Helm >= 3.17
```

or, on older Helm, hand them over first (replace `<release>` and `<namespace>`):

```sh
kubectl annotate crd agentgatewaybackends.agentgateway.dev agentgatewaymodels.agentgateway.dev agentgatewayparameters.agentgateway.dev agentgatewaypolicies.agentgateway.dev \
  meta.helm.sh/release-name=<release> meta.helm.sh/release-namespace=<namespace> --overwrite
kubectl label crd agentgatewaybackends.agentgateway.dev agentgatewaymodels.agentgateway.dev agentgatewayparameters.agentgateway.dev agentgatewaypolicies.agentgateway.dev \
  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by=Helm --overwrite
```
